ella_cs: Weekly check-in for account 'NovaPay' — quick p95/p99 snapshot by route/model (streaming vs sync). Dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/nova-pay. TL;DR: streaming p95 ~120ms, p99 ~540ms on /chat routes; sync p95 ~80ms, p99 ~220ms. Notable spike: model 'redwood-7b-q4' on streaming /assistant/generate had p99 ~1.2s (↑3x). Spend +18% WoW (~$14.2k). Renewal touchpoint next week, flagging risk.

miguel_sre: seeing the same in infra. GPU pool for dedicated-novapay spiked Wed 10:30-11:15 UTC. Batching concurrency jumped. Any recent canaries?

ayana_eng: we pushed kv-cache/batching canary Tue 09:00 UTC on the pool. Could be interaction with continuous batching + new kernel selection. I'll profile model runtime. Quick query I ran to pull percentiles:

```sql
SELECT route, model, mode,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95,
  percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p99
FROM metrics.latency
WHERE account_id='nova-pay' AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route, model, mode;
```

sam_ops: can we throttle streaming batching defaults for NovaPay temporarily? Customers are seeing regressions and cost bump. What's the rollback plan?

jess_sales: FYI renewal lead asked if we can commit to p99 < 500ms. They're nervous about the 1.2s spike. Might push pause if not resolved quickly.

miguel_sre: immediate action: revert canary (kv-cache/batching) on dedicated-novapay pool tonight at 22:00 UTC. I'll schedule rollback and watch metrics. If rollback not safe we'll throttle batching to max_batch=8.

metrics-bot: Automated snapshot — p95_streaming: 120ms (prev 110ms); p99_streaming: 540ms (prev 180ms); p99 for model redwood-7b-q4 (streaming) peaked 1.2s at Wed 10:44 UTC. GPU util for pool hit 96% during spike. Links: https://redwood.app/metrics/snapshots/2980011223

ella_cs: Thanks. I'll add this to the renewal brief and schedule an enablement call with the customer. Also capturing a representative prompt set and logs for replay/eval.

ayana_eng: I'll run a targeted evaluation across 200 streaming prompts vs sync this afternoon and post a short CSV with p95/p99 by model+route.

sam_ops: note on spend: if we revert to earlier config it may increase token-costs briefly due to lower batching efficiency, but should reduce p99 spikes. Current weekly spend for NovaPay = $14.2k (+18% WoW).

jess_sales: If rollback shows improvement, I can stall the renewal discussion 48h. Need a before/after snapshot to show to the customer.

miguel_sre: :thumbsup: I'll post rollback start/end and metrics in this thread. Plan: rollback 22:00 UTC, validation window 22:05-23:00 UTC, then confirm.

ella_cs: Action items (owners): 1) Miguel: rollback + post confirmation. 2) Ayana: eval + results (EOD). 3) Sam: finance sync (tomorrow). 4) Jess: hold renewal ask until we have results. 5) Metrics-bot: post after-rollback snapshot. Please @mention if anything changes.

metrics-bot: Note: will publish pre/post snapshots and a small diff for p95/p99 by route+model automatically once rollback completes.

ella_cs: thanks all — will update NovaPay CSM notes and prep talking points for renewal call.
